description: SEC filing changes since a timestamp. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secfilings/changes.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior /changes call

form.description: Optional form filter (exact or base form)

ticker.description: Ticker symbol — provide cik OR ticker
